balls.text: an anti-climactic end to the innings! Slow and short outside off. Jurel gets up on his toes and pulls it on the bounce to deep mid wicket. Just a single, and the Royals end up with 205!

this is superb batting! Slower bumper outside off that is so short that Stoinis' toe-nail is lucky it is still intact. Jurel waits and waits and waits and waits for it before upper-cutting it over the keeper's head!

Jurel wants a piece of Stoinis too, and stop the press folks, because 200 has been breached in the IPL at Mullanpur! Juicy full toss that also offers Jurel some swinging room. He tees it up and smokes it over cow corner!
back of a length wide outside off. Parag reaches out for it and chalks it off the toe-end towards long off. Stoinis did well to get it outside Parag's arc on that occasion
right out of the screws! Oh my goodness - that has travelled! Off-pace and this sits up nicely outside off. Parag picks it early and then clatters it a mile over deep mid wicket! An 88m six!
back of a length on off. Jurel opens up his stance and hacks it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single
off-pace on a back of a length just outside off. Jurel jabs it enough to extra cover's left and gets off the mark

Hetmyer shanks this, and Hetmyer perishes! Low full toss tailing into leg stump. Hetmyer looks to slog it over cow corner but gets under it too much. Gets more height than distance and Maxwell, stationed at long on, was never going to drop that. Easy as you like, and Arshdeep has his first wicket of the evening!

that is a serious shot! Banged into the track outside off. Hetmyer stands up tall and clubs the living daylights out of this one. Deep mid wicket did not have to move a lot to his right but he still had no chance!
low full toss outside off. Parag clinks it down the ground towards long off
another cutter bowled into the track outside off. Hetmyer plays a forehand like Rafael Nadal once used to but only picks up a single to extra cover
slower ball into the track wide outside off. Hetmyer drags it into the mid wicket region and then hurtles back for two. He called for two early and showed enough conviction
low full toss on middle and off. Hetmyer jams down on it and digs it out towards long on
safe again! Back of a length outside off. Parag looks to tonk it into tomorrow and miscues it so badly that it barely crosses the ring in the mid on region. Maxwell (stood at long on) had no chance

goes straight up, and goes straight down! Slower ball hung up full and wide. Parag is too early into the stroke and chips it a mile up. Jansen calls early, runs back but cannot lay hands on it as the ball drops inside the circle in the mid on region!

serious whippage, and Parag has back-to-back sixes! Half-volley on the pads and it gets the treatment it deserves. Parag does so with a flourish (literally and figuratively), and dumps it over the fine leg season!
Parag goes bang! No problems spotting this slower one! Back of a length outside off and this sits up. Parag watches it all the way and bulldozes it over long on!
slower ball, angling in full on leg stump. Hetmyer plays all around his flick and the ball dribbles off his pad towards short third
back of a length just outside off. Hetmyer gets up on his toes and stabs it towards mid off

through the hands! Oh dear - that might come back to sting PBKS! Shortish outside leg. Hetmyer gets inside the line and hacks it towards fine leg. Chahal runs around but the ball just bursts through his hands. Not the greatest of efforts, but just the outcome RR would have wanted!

off-pace again but hung up wider outside off. Parag swishes and misses, and the keeper cannot gather either. Two bonus runs for RR. PBKS have reviewed this, and this is touch-and-go. Right on the line and the third umpire says no part of the ball is inside the guideline. Wide call stays!
another slower bumper outside off and another wild swing and miss (surprise, surprise). Parag is not reading these off the hand and has not been able to adjust at all
slower ball on a back of a length outside off, and Parag is back to his duty of swatting away flies. A couple of business days early on that one

oh dear - that is a terrible mix-up and probably a worse throw! Dug into the track just outside off. Hetmyer knocks it into the mid wicket region. Parag wants the second, Hetmyer does not. Ferguson gives chase initially but cannot get the throw away. Shedge with the throw but that is straight into the turf and bounces up sluggishly, allowing Parag to get back
back of a length, angling across the batter outside off. Hetmyer goes chasing after it but cannot catch hold of it
dispatched! Off-pace again but now, Parag is waiting and perhaps even setting up for it. Lines up this back of a length ball outside off and thunders it over the bowler's head!
Parag plays with the field, and finds the fence! Attempted wide yorker but Arshdeep misses on the shorter side, allowing Parag to get under it and knife it over short third!
slower bumper just outside off. Parag keeps swinging like a rusty gate and keeps missing
back of a length outside off. Parag does not pick the slower one again and swings too early. Only grabs a handful of fresh air this time
off-pace and dug into the track outside off. Parag has an ungainly swipe at it and chalks it off the toe-end towards the keeper
slower ball on a back of a length, finishing just outside off. Parag opens his bat face and runs it down to short third. Wanted the single too but his partner was not as interested
Hetmyer is off the mark in style! Jansen goes short again outside off and Hetmyer reads it like the morning newspaper. He stands up on his toes and belts it past mid wicket!
zipped into Hetmyer, attacking the stumps. He is a little rushed on the stroke and cramped for room too on this shortish ball. Defends it towards the bowler

goes straight up, and snared on the fence! Thrown up full and wide outside off, making Rana access an area he does not want to. He throws his hands at it anyway and slices across it too much. That brings Maxwell into play on the deep cover fence and he runs around to complete the catch. RR lose another, and PBKS keep chipping away!
back of a length on middle and leg. Rana moves across his stumps, trying to lap it away. Fails to lay bat on ball for the second ball running
off-pace again but sliding down leg. Rana looks for the pick-up shot over fine leg but fails to make contact. Called a wide
slower yorker on middle and leg. Dips on Parag late and that makes him reach out in front a touch. Skews off the leading edge towards backward point
dug into the track just outside off. Rana gets inside the line and helps it towards fine leg
back of a length just outside off. Rana hangs back and taps it towards deep point to keep strike
back of a length on middle and leg. Rana gets across his stumps and works it into the vacant deep mid wicket region for a brace

four more - Rana is motoring along already! Slanted into the slot on middle and off. Rana gives himself room, peels the outer cover off the ball and scythes it over backward point. That was bowled at 143.6kph but did not matter to Rana one bit!
Rana begins from where he left off in Guwahati! Back of a length outside off and this sits up to be hit. Rana gets his hands through the ball and crashes it past extra cover!
darted in way down leg. Rana does not get bat on it and Prabhsimran does enough to get something behind it. Called a wide

off stump goes for a toss, and Ferguson is pumped! Beautifully-disguised slower ball, pitching on a length just outside off. Jaiswal thinks he can slog this into oblivion over cow corner but does not pick the variation. Swings too early, swats away a few flies and then sees his off stump cartwheeling. Ferguson loved that, and pretty sure PBKS and their fans would have too!
hard length, pitching just outside off and nipping back in. Parag plays all around it and the ball flies off his back leg. On the bounce to Stoinis at deep third
Jaiswal is ripping Stoinis apart now! This is fuller and much wider outside off. Jaiswal does well to reach it and then he generates the power needed to thrash it past extra cover!
oh, hello - that has gone miles! Right in the slot just outside off. Jaiswal opens up his stance and smears it over wide long on!
slower ball on a length on middle and leg. Parag glances it towards short fine leg

Parag joins in on the fun now! Not the most convincing stroke he will ever play in his life, but it will do for now. Slower bumper outside off. Parag swishes wildly at it and the ball skews off the top edge over short fine leg
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal winds up and flat-bats it towards long off
pushed in on a length on off. Parag comes forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket. Jaiswal hares down for the second, only to be sent back. Has to sprawl to regain his ground
high into the night sky, and well beyond the fence! This is even slower but again into the arc, just outside off. Jaiswal gets down on the sweep and wallops it over deep mid wicket!
smashed to the fence! Floated up into the slot outside off. Jaiswal clears his front leg, goes through the line and blasts it past long off. Fifty for Jaiswal too - his first this season!
floated up full on leg stump. Parag gets a big stride forward and glances it towards short fine leg
fizzed in on a back of a length on leg stump. Grips in the surface and that squares up Parag, who prods it towards backward point
slower on a back of a length on middle and leg. Jaiswal goes back and tugs it towards long on
fired in full on middle and leg. Parag comes forward and pushes it towards long off
back of a length on the pads. Parag gets inside the line, uses the angle and glances it towards fine leg
full outside off. Jaiswal plants his front foot and scuffs it down the ground to long off
full and wide outside off. Jaiswal tries to smash it into next week and only swishes at thin air
back of a length in the channel. Straightens a touch and Parag dangles his bat, with the ball rolling off the outside edge towards deep third

straight to mid off this time, and the RR captain is outta here! Bowls it full again, just outside off. Samson, rather than trying to go along the carpet, looks to go up and over mid off. Does not get under it enough and offers the simplest of catches. Samson throws his bat away in disappointment, and that is a massive moment in the game!
splits the field with surgical precision! Slower ball that ends up being a half-volley outside off. Samson goes through the line and cracks it between extra cover and mid off!
off-pace again, on a back of a length outside off. Samson miscues his cut and the ball trickles towards extra cover

well well! Slower ball dug into the track wide outside off. Jaiswal shapes for the reverse-ramp, has his evening cup of tea, plans what he wants to have for dinner and then helps it towards short third. It was that slow
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Jaiswal cannot come to grips with the lack of pace and scuffs it towards extra cover
back of a length, angling into the hips. Samson misses his swing and the ball rolls off his thigh pad towards short fine leg
full on off. Jaiswal tries to hit it too hard and loses his shape completely. Shanks it to deep mid wicket
short and wide outside off. Jaiswal moves across early and cuts it enough to deep point's left to canter back for two
full on middle and leg. Jaiswal, despite advancing, cannot create the swinging room he wants and pivots to flicking it to deep mid wicket instead
fizzed in on a length outside off. Samson drives it on the up to sweeper cover
flighted up full just outside off. Jaiswal gets down on one knee and drags it towards short fine leg
thrown up full and wide, as a riposte to Jaiswal shaping to play the reverse-sweep. He gets flummoxed by the change of line and only swishes at thin air
fuller, flatter and quicker on middle and leg. Samson eases it to long on
gets the radar right this time. On a length on leg stump and that spins back sharply. Jaiswal squeezes it out into the off side. Might have been pad-first actually
oh dear! Fired in short and a mile down leg. Jaiswal does not get bat on it and the keeper had no chance of getting there either. Bonus runs for RR!
off-pace and into the track outside off. Jaiswal waits for it and swipes it towards deep mid wicket
length ball on the pads. Samson uses the angle and works it towards deep mid wicket
shot! That is sumptuous! Full on middle and leg. Samson takes a step deep into his crease and then shows the maker's name to cream it back past the bowler!
back of a length outside off. Samson waits for the slower one but cannot cut it past backward point
very full on middle and leg. Jaiswal jams down on it and digs it out towards long on
slower delivery banged into the track outside off. Jaiswal shapes for the upper-cut but is too early on the stroke
googly fired in very full on leg stump. Jaiswal tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket
full on middle and leg. Samson gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it to long on
tossed up full on leg stump. Jaiswal lunges forward and pokes it towards long on
back of a length on middle and off. Samson goes back and eases it to long off
dragged down and put away! Too short and too much time for Samson to make the most of this. He hops deep into his crease and hammers it between long on and deep mid wicket!
googly on a back of a length on off. Jaiswal stays back and knocks it to long on
given a bit of air on a length just outside off. Samson presses forward and prods it towards the bowler, who fields it to his right on his follow-through
back of a length on middle and off. Sticks in the surface a little and Samson stabs it towards mid off
back of a length on middle and leg. Jaiswal turns it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Samson goes back and knocks it to long on
shorter, wider and Samson is all over it like a rash! Sits up nicely for the RR skipper and he rocks back to thread it between extra cover and cover!
short outside off and Samson misses out. Punches it straight to extra cover off the back foot

full outside off. Jaiswal drives it into the pitch and the ball bounces up for Maxwell at cover point. The crowd erupts thinking it is a catch but it is only a crowd-catch (which is a bump ball basically)
fullish outside off. Jaiswal gets his front foot out of the way again and drills it. Straight to mid off, though
Jaiswal is dining out in Mullanpur now! A touch short just outside off and that is all Jaiswal needs. He opens up his front hip and slams it over mid on!
full just outside off. Jaiswal punches it towards mid off. Hit that so firm that he could not call for the single either
angled in full on off. Samson hangs back and pokes it towards mid off
starts off with a jaffa! Back of a length in the channel, threatening to come in. On pitching, the ball moves away and that turns Samson inside out. Beaten all ends up!
length on middle and off. Samson sits deep in his crease and drives it on the up towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal stands tall and hacks it towards mid on for a single
fetch that too, says Jaiswal! Marginally short just outside off. Jaiswal gets his front foot out of the way this time and clobbers it over deep square leg!
clever, clever batting! Banged into the track outside off. Rather than trying to fight it, Jaiswal uses it. Waits for the ball and upper-cuts it with minimal fuss over the keeper's head!
back of a length just outside off. Samson drops it behind point and looks at his partner, who responds and saunters across to complete the run
regal! Full on the pads and Samson is not going to miss out. He snaps his wrists into action and clips it delightfully to mid on's right!
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and jabs it towards extra cover
back of a length in the channel. Moves away slightly and that is enough to take it past Jaiswal's flailing blade
gets this much better, and gets four too! Perhaps a touch shorter and not cramping Jaiswal for room as much. More extension of the arms and he muscles it over mid on!
just over! Shortish just outside off and this swings back in sharply. Gets big on Jaiswal too and he splices his pull, getting just enough to clear Shreyas at mid on
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal has another massive swish at it and this time, only connects with fresh air
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal throws his hands at it and slices it over cover point. The ball plugs in the outfield and Jaiswal has to settle for two
shortish just outside off. Jaiswal opens up his stance and heaves at it with all his might. Drags it towards long leg and has to be content with a single
hard length, angling into middle and leg. Tucked up for room, Jaiswal stabs it towards mid on
hard length just outside off. Jaiswal hangs back, meets the ball right under his eyes and dabs it towards short third
back of a length outside off and this jags away a great deal. Kicks up off the surface too and whistles past Jaiswal's flailing blade
length on leg stump. Samson presses half forward and pushes it into the vacant mid wicket region
short and wide outside off. Jaiswal reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep backward point
short on leg stump. Jaiswal swivels nicely and pulls it on the bounce towards deep backward square leg. Shedge nearly over-runs it to his left but does enough in the end to keep it to one
back of a length on middle and leg. Jaiswal hangs back and pokes it towards mid on

back of a length on leg stump. Samson goes back and punches it exquisitely past mid on. The ball keeps running away from Maxwell but he lunges at it in the nick of time. The throw is great too, and had it been a direct hit, Samson would have been on his way
Samson is up and running! Shortish and swinging into the hip. With fine leg square, that is easy pickings for Samson and he swipes it away fine!
back of a length on middle stump. Cramps Samson up for room and he is happy to drop the ball right beside him with soft hands
back of a length on middle and off. Shapes away a touch and Jaiswal allows the ball to come to him before helping it round the corner
back of a length wide outside off and this swings away further. Jaiswal swishes at it and misses and the umpire has to indulge in some early exercise

Ferguson finds the fence, and that should be the end of the game. Or is it?! Yorker just outside off. Ferguson gives himself room and carves it past backward point. Everyone is happy to indulge in the post-game handshakes, but the umpires want to check if RR had enough fielders inside the ring. The check is still ongoing, and we wait...Samson has sat down on the turf because of how long this is taking, and pretty sure he might not be the only one (including those watching at home) to be feeling that way. Samson gets up finally and we have reached a conclusion. And no, this is not a drill. The Rajasthan Royals have rocked up in Mullanpur and they have taken down the Punjab Kings and their previously-unbeaten record! And do not let those final shenanigans take away from what has been a thoroughly professional performance by the visitors!

straight to extra cover, and Archer has another! Very full on leg stump. Arshdeep backs away, trying to go inside out. Cannot get under it enough, though, and does not keep it down either. Chips it straight to Hasaranga, who snaffles up a sharp low chance!
full ball on the pads. Shashank gets inside the line and is happy to just work it towards deep backward square leg for a single
sharp bumper on middle and off that arrives onto Shashank a lot quicker than he expects. Tries to help it away but gets tagged on the body. Might have ricocheted onto the grille as well
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Shashank has an ungainly swipe across the line and only swats away a few flies in the process
on a length on middle and off. Shashank knocks it towards long on but gets sent back, when trying to take a single or even try the second. Arshdeep did not move a muscle at the other end
off-pace on a length on leg stump. Arshdeep has a wild slog at it and jams it off the inside edge into his back leg
low full toss just outside off. Shashank rolls his wrists and whisks it towards deep square leg
back of a length wide outside off. Shashank takes a step across and then swishes at it with all his might. Only grabs a handful of fresh air
into the blockhole on the pads. Shashank works it away towards deep backward square leg and bags a brace
into the blockhole on middle and off. Arshdeep jams down on it and squeezes it out to deep backward square leg
full and angling into leg stump. Shashank helicopters it on the bounce to long on
length just outside off. Arshdeep plants his front foot and powers it on the bounce to long on

Theekshana appeals and appeals and appeals, but the umpire says no! Samson reviews promptly! Back of a length, pitching on middle stump and zipping through with the angle. Arshdeep, having taken a step across, plays all around it to get pinned on the front pad. Might have been going past off stump with the angle but let's see what the replays have in store for us. No bat involved, and Ball Tracking reckons the ball would have missed off stump, with the impact also Umpire's Call. RR out of reviews!

you cannot escape Hetmyer on the fence - not tonight! Very full just outside off. Jansen, sitting deep in his crease, tries to use his wrists to shovel it over deep mid wicket. Gets good power on it but not enough elevation. Hetmyer slaloms around to his left and pouches it, while also ensuring he does not roll onto the boundary cushion. PBKS on the brink now!
well well! Theekshana rattles this one in, full outside off. Jansen shapes for the reverse but does not make any contact at all
fullish outside off. Shashank plants his front foot and chips it over extra cover. There is a sweeper on the deep cover fence for exactly this stroke, though
fuller and wider outside off. Samson cannot gather either and Shashank smuggles in another run. Two bonus runs for the Kings, although that may not matter much in the grander scheme of things
carrom ball on a back of a length outside off. Jansen swings for the hills and misses the ball by a fair margin. Did not read that at all
brilliant yorker, honing into the toes. Jansen digs it out towards deep mid wicket and has to be content with a single
another top yorker on leg stump. Shashank shuffles across and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
back of a length just outside off. Jansen stands up tall and chips it towards long on. No real power on that stroke either
into the blockhole just outside off. Shashank cannot get under it and squeezes it out past the bowler for a single
on a length and a mile outside off. Shashank lets it go and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
fullish on the pads. Jansen presses forward and flicks it on the bounce to deep mid wicket. Almost wicket number 52 at the death for Sandeep

Sandeep breaks through again, and Shedge bites the dust! Slower ball banged into the track wide outside off. This is so short that it is on the way down by the time Shedge makes contact. Due to that, he cannot generate the velocity he wants and spoons it up towards deep point. Hetmyer circles under it and gobbles up the chance to leave the Kings reeling further!
back of a length on middle and off. Shedge hangs back and works it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single and just five runs off the 16th over. World-class from Hasaranga!
tossed up full outside off. Shashank winds up and hoicks it towards long on

massive lbw shout, not given! Angled in on a length on middle and leg. Shedge plays all around it and gets rapped on the pads. Hasaranga and Samson are quite confident, and Samson, in the end, reviews. Did the ball straighten enough? If it did not, this is definitely sliding down leg. Well, this looks much closer than it initially seemed. No bat involved and Ball Tracking has the ball clipping leg stump. Umpire's Call and Shedge survives!
back of a length on leg stump. Shashank goes back and eases it to deep mid wicket to get off the mark
slowed up on a full length on off. Shedge has a wild slog at it first up and drags it towards deep square leg

Hasaranga into the wickets too, and the Sri Lankan spin-twins are doing the job for the Rajasthan Royals! Floated up full and wide, Wadhera tries to slog it over cow corner but is always fighting against the angle. Cloths it off the bottom part of the bat and that brings Jurel into play at deep mid wicket. He hares in off the fence, swoops forward and picks it up inches off the turf!

and he caps off an excellent over with the humongous wicket of Glenn Maxwell! Oh my - that is a moment and a half in this contest! Carrom ball hung up wide outside off. Maxwell tries to fetch it, looking to go over long off. Has to reach out too much, though, meaning he cuts across it. Jaiswal settles under it at long off and does the rest. Maxwell is livid with himself as he storms off; RR, meanwhile, absolutely over the moon!
back of a length, hung up wide outside off. Wadhera reaches out for it and flat-bats it to long off
slanted in full and down leg. Wadhera swings at it and misses, and the umpire calls it a wide. Good take by Samson
zipped into the blockhole outside off, perhaps after seeing Wadhera backing away. He backs away too much in the end and cannot reach it
back of a length outside off. Wadhera laces his cut but cannot get it past extra cover. He will feel he missed out there
four more! Wadhera is sparing no one now! Darted in full and following Wadhera outside leg. Wadhera, though, has planned for this too. Rolls his wrists and clips it to short fine leg's right!
starts the over with a boundary! On a length just outside off. Wadhera marches down the track and muscles it between long on and deep mid wicket!
back of a length wide outside off. Wadhera slaps it down the ground to long off
follows Maxwell outside leg with a full ball. Maxwell cannot get under it and drags it towards deep mid wicket
fuller and wider outside off. Wadhera reaches out for it and drags it towards long on

is it enough? Is it enough? Oh, you bet it is! Slower on a length just outside off. Wadhera dances down the track and despite not being to the pitch of the ball, goes through with the stroke, hoisting it over long on. Brings up his fifty too, and does so in style!
googly on a length just outside off. Wadhera gets caught on the crease and defends
back of a length outside off. Wadhera flat-bats it powerfully back past the bowler. Long on, though, sprawls across to his right and saves two. Jaiswal the fielder

Audacious with a capital A! Off-pace on a back of a length on middle and leg. Maxwell brings out the reverse and despite having to wait for the ball while being in that position, executes it brilliantly to clear short third!
back of a length on middle and off. Wadhera nurdles it towards deep mid wicket and calls for two. Maxwell, though, says no, rather audibly
off-pace on a back of a length on off. Maxwell opens his bat face and guides it towards backward point

hang on, what has happened here?! Much fuller but again tailing down leg. Maxwell looks to flick and misses, but RR does not seem to think so. Samson appeals, and then goes upstairs! The bat is close to the ball but a flat line on UltraEdge. Ulhas Gandhe's decision vindicated, RR burn a review, and Maxwell stays. The wide call remains too!
another wayward short ball. This time, Maxwell does not even attempt playing at it and umpire Ulhas Gandhe has to indulge in more exercise. Called two for the over as well
banged into the track and this slides down leg. Maxwell swings at it and misses, and called a wide. Called one bouncer for the over too

Maxwell made that look ridiculously easy! Back of a length on middle and leg. Maxwell gives himself a bit of room and then peels the outer cover off the ball, like most people peel off a mango. Scythes it between backward point and short third!
slow, short and wide outside off. Maxwell reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point for another brace. Smart work on the fence by Hetmyer
slower ball on a back of a length on leg stump. Maxwell cannot come to grips with it quick enough and misses his swipe, getting rapped on the body in the process
back of a length on the pads. Maxwell stabs it towards deep square leg

shortens the length after seeing Wadhera advance. He adjusts and places it perfectly between deep mid wicket and deep square leg. Runs back for two but there is an error in Yudhvir backing up the throw, which allows a third
follows the batter well outside leg with a full ball. Maxwell tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Wadhera goes back and punches it to long on
googly on a back of a length outside off. Keeps quite low and Wadhera pokes it towards extra cover
flat as a tank! Given air outside off and this lands right in the slot. Wadhera extends his arms and slams it flat over the wide long on fence!
into the blockhole perfectly this time, on off stump. Wadhera clinks it out to long on
off-spinner, darted in as a low full toss just outside off. Maxwell opens his bat face and drives it towards sweeper cover
length ball hung up wide outside off. Maxwell looks for the reverse but for a change, only swishes at thin air
fired in full on middle and leg. Wadhera flicks it towards deep mid wicket
carrom ball on a back of a length outside off. Hacked down the ground to long on
back of a length on middle and off. Wadhera works it towards deep mid wicket
loopy low full toss on off. Wadhera stretches forward and eases it to long on
Wadhera goes big too, and Kartikeya will be feeling the pinch now! Flighted up into the slot just outside off. Wadhera drops down to one knee and slugs it flat over deep mid wicket!
back of a length on middle and off. Maxwell goes back and jabs it towards deep backward point
follows up the six with a four! Shortish on middle and off. Maxwell waits for this and with the deftest of touches, helps it fine!
bam! Maxwell turns it on! Slower, loopier and also landing in the slot just outside leg. Maxwell gets his front foot out of the way and launches it over long on!
back of a length on off. Wadhera goes back and bunts it towards long on. He was thinking about two at the start but was sent back by Maxwell
back of a length outside off. Spins back into Wadhera, while also holding in the surface and he knocks it to long off
on a length on leg stump. Maxwell gets forward and turns it behind square
googly on a back of a length outside off. Wadhera goes back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
shot! Given a bit of air on a full length on middle and off. Wadhera unfurls the reverse and helps it over short third. Much-needed boundary!
floated up full on leg stump. Maxwell comes forward and nudges it into the mid wicket region
dragged down outside off. Wadhera sits deep in his crease and hauls it on the bounce to long on. Good work by Jaiswal to his left
sharp bumper to greet Maxwell. Just a little outside off, though, and that allows Maxwell to sway out of the way
shortish on leg stump. Wadhera gets inside the line, swivels and pulls it towards long leg
dug into the track outside off. Wadhera hacks it towards mid wicket. Tried to hit it too hard and could not time it well enough
back of a length just outside off. Wadhera gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
Wadhera with a riposte! Back of a length just outside off. Wadhera picks the length early, gets into position and tugs it to mid on's right!
and so are the jaffas! Length in the channel and this decks away just a smidgen. Wadhera nibbles at it and is beaten all ends up. Nice carry too!
shortish outside off. Wadhera hops back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
floated up full on middle and off. Maxwell gets his front foot out of the way and drags it towards deep mid wicket
fullish on leg stump. Maxwell gets onto the front foot and pokes it towards mid wicket
peach! Googly tossed up full just outside off. Maxwell goes searching for it in front of his pad and gets beaten as the ball fizzes past the outside edge

soft, soft dismissal, and RR have four inside seven overs! Googly on a length on middle and leg. Prabhsimran looks for the good'ol slog over cow corner but the lack of pace does him in. He gets beaten in the air too and that means he clanks it right off the toe-end to deep mid wicket. Hasaranga makes no mistake, and Samson is delighted, as is the bowler!
shortish just outside leg. Cramps Prabhsimran on the cut and he cannot get it past cover point
very full on off. Wadhera advances but cannot get under it. Digs it out towards extra cover
slower ball on a back of a length on leg stump and this just does not get up. Wadhera looks to help it away and gets a bit of bat, with the ball dribbling towards the keeper
another excellent yorker, right under the bat, despite Prabhsimran advancing. He clinks it out to deep mid wicket
into the blockhole, following Wadhera outside leg as he steps down. He jams down on it and squeezes it out into the on side
full on the pads. Prabhsimran tucks it away towards deep square leg
slower ball on a full length on the stumps. Wadhera advances and eases it into the mid on region
back of a length on middle and off. Wadhera uses the angle and turns it towards deep mid wicket
full and flat just outside off. Prabhsimran flicks it down the ground to long on

put down - oh dear! Slower on a full length on middle and leg. Wadhera backs away and looks to go down the ground. Makes a mess of it and spoons it towards long on. Jurel comes tearing in and then grasses the chance. Parag, running back from mid off, was also very interested and they made a meal of it in the end
clears the ring! Hung up on a length wide outside off. Wadhera brings out the sweep and gets it just over backward square leg
fired in full on off. Prabhsimran gets down on one knee and drags it towards deep mid wicket
darted in full and also darted down leg. Prabhsimran misses it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length, targeting the stumps. Wadhera eases it to long on
oh wow - what a shot that is! Zipped in full just outside off. Prabhsimran shuffles across, gets his bat down and gets the angle of the bat perfectly right. Scoops it cleanly over short fine leg!
back of a length on middle and off. Prabhsimran gets squared up a touch and prods it into the off side
back of a length on leg stump. Wadhera takes a step down the track and tucks it uppishly off his hips towards deep square leg

simple as you like, and the Punjab Kings are three down in a trice! Back of a length on middle and off. Sticks in the surface and Stoinis, trying to punch it back past the bowler, offers the most regulation of chances to Sandeep. The bowler snaps it up and then throws the ball up into the air in celebration. Stoinis departs too, and this PBKS chase is wobbling!
back of a length just outside off. Stoinis goes deep into his crease and punches it towards extra cover
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Prabhsimran advances and pushes it into the cover region for a quick single

was that a chance?! Hard length just outside off. Prabhsimran clears his front leg and swings his blade like an axe. Makes no contact and that is too hot to handle even for Samson. Seemed like there was a sound as ball passed bat but given as a bye
safe, just! Back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran looks to go downtown and cloths it completely. Fortunately for him, it has enough legs to clear mid off
back of a length on leg stump. Stoinis has a very tentative prod at it and the ball flies off the inside edge towards short fine leg. That was bowled at 145.9kph
oh dear - bonus runs for the Kings! Banged into the track on middle and off. Sails over Stoinis's head and is also beyond Samson's reach. Not called a wide, given as four byes!
back of a length on middle and leg. Decks back sharply and whizzes past Stoinis' bat long before it comes down. Raps him on the back leg
hard length on middle and leg. Cramps the batter for room and Prabhsimran tips it into the mid wicket region to scurry across for a single
slanted in full on middle and off. Stoinis comes half forward and pokes it towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Shapes away late and Stoinis is happy to let it go
back of a length on middle and off. Prabhsimran gets up on his toes and drops it into the mid wicket region
ripper! Back of a length in the channel. Threatens to angle in but leaves the batter late instead. Prabhsimran is opened up like a deck chair and beaten all ends up
shorter and wider outside off. Prabhsimran absolutely middles this square cut but cannot get it past cover point
another gorgeous stroke to get off the mark! A bit of a long half-volley, laced with width. Prabhsimran leans into the drive and times it exquisitely past extra cover!

Archer smashes into Shreyas' stumps, and that is an enormous blow for the Punjab Kings! 148.6kph heat-seeking missile, angled in on a length on middle and leg and truth be told, this is an awful stroke. Shreyas backs away, tries to cart it into the Himalayas and loses track of it completely. Gets nowhere near the ball and hears the death rattle soon after. Shreyas cannot believe what he has done, and Archer, just like that, has dented the Kings with a haymaker!
back of a length just outside off. Shreyas stays leg side and dabs it towards backward point, whose misfield allows a couple of runs
short ball that slides just down leg. Shreyas thinks about the pull initially before bailing out of the stroke at the last moment. Good call in the end. That was bowled at 151.3kph!

this is even better! Shreyas has come to play tonight! Length outside off and Shreyas climbs into this. Steps forward, shows the full face and carves it over extra cover. Holds the pose too, and why wouldn't he!
dug into the track now, just outside off. Shreyas gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side
oof, stop that, Shreyas Iyer! Archer goes full and bowls it into the slot outside off. Shreyas plants his front foot and crrrrrrrrrrunnnnnnnnnnchhhhhesssss it over extra cover. Right then!

an absolute corker to start things off, and Arya does not know what has hit him! 144.6kph thunderbolt, pitching on leg stump and then nipping away sharply. Arya tries to play down the original line but the ball is just too good for him. Breezes past his bat and then knocks the top of off stump. Dream delivery, from a bowler who at his best is a dream bowler for most teams. PBKS rocked early!
